name: Ogiso Setsuna
source: Third-year student at Houjou High School where she is regarded as an idol by her peers, having been honored with the title of Miss Houjou High for two consecutive years. A talented singer with a bright personality, she has a passion for karaoke and particularly enjoys singing "White Album", a song from [url=/v236]the first White Album visual novel[/url].
